activities.title: Listen to Oliver's best day. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.script: Ingrid: So Oliver, tell us about the best day ever! … Oliver: The summer festival, last year. Our band played on the big stage! … Ingrid: How many people were there? … Oliver: Five hundred! The biggest audience of my life. … Ingrid: But wasn't there a storm? … Oliver: Yes! In the middle of our song the rain started. And you know what? Nobody left! … Oliver: Everybody sang under their umbrellas. It was the most beautiful sound I've ever heard. … Ingrid: And the worst moment? … Oliver: When my guitar string broke… but Maya fixed it in two minutes. Best team ever!
